apropos.title: About AlloAppart
apropos.subtitle: AlloAppart is the leading real-estate marketplace in Senegal — connecting tenants and landlords with verified listings and a dedicated field team.
apropos.missionText: Our mission is to make renting in Senegal simple, transparent, and trustworthy. By combining technology and field expertise, AlloAppart removes the friction of traditional real-estate search — giving every Senegalese the ability to find a home that fits their needs and budget.
apropos.alloVerText: AlloVérifié™ is our unique quality seal. Each property listed on AlloAppart is physically visited and assessed by a certified field agent before publication. Photos, surface area, amenities, and pricing are all cross-checked to guarantee accuracy and protect both landlords and tenants.

objet.title: 1. Purpose and scope
objet.body:
These Terms of Service (ToS) govern access to and use of the AlloAppart platform, available at www.alloappart.sn and operated by AlloAppart SN SARL.

Any use of the platform implies full and unreserved acceptance of these ToS. These ToS are governed by Senegalese law, in particular the Code of Civil and Commercial Obligations (COCC) and Law No. 2008-11 of 25 January 2008 on cybercrime.

definitions.title: 2. Definitions
definitions.body:
• Platform: the AlloAppart website and mobile applications.
• User: any natural or legal person who has created an account on the Platform.
• Landlord: a user offering a property for rent.
• Tenant: a user looking for a property to rent.
• Listing: a publication describing a property available for rent.
• AlloVerified™: a quality label awarded to listings that have undergone an on-site inspection by a certified AlloAppart agent.

inscription.title: 3. Registration and user account
inscription.body:
Access to the full features of the Platform is reserved for natural persons aged at least 18 and for legally constituted legal entities.

Users undertake to provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information when registering. Any identity theft or provision of false information may result in immediate account suspension and legal proceedings in accordance with applicable Senegalese law.

bailleurs.title: 4. Landlord obligations
bailleurs.body:
Landlords undertake to:
• Publish listings that accurately reflect the property (recent photos, exact floor area, actual condition).
• Guarantee that the property is genuinely available at the time of publication.
• State accurate rental prices including all applicable charges.
• Not publish properties they do not own or are not legitimately mandated to represent.
• Comply with Senegalese regulations applicable to residential leases.

locataires.title: 5. Tenant obligations
locataires.body:
Tenants undertake to:
• Use the Platform fairly and honestly.
• Respect landlords and their properties during viewings.
• Not contact landlords outside the Platform in order to circumvent these ToS.
• Not submit fraudulent rental requests or false identities.

allverifie.title: 6. AlloVerified™
allverifie.body:
AlloVerified™ is an on-site inspection commitment carried out by certified AlloAppart agents. A listing bearing this label has been physically visited and key information has been checked (condition of the property, floor area, amenities, accuracy of photos).

Limit of warranty: AlloVerified™ does not constitute a legal warranty of the lease agreement and does not engage AlloAppart's liability for any disputes arising after the lease is signed between landlord and tenant.

tarifs.title: 7. Fees and commissions
tarifs.body:
• Publishing listings: free for individual landlords.
• Commission: 5% of the first month's rent for any completed transaction facilitated by the Platform (a direct introduction that led to the signing of a lease).
• Fees may be amended with 30 days' notice sent by email to registered users.

propriete.title: 8. Intellectual property
propriete.body:
The AlloAppart trademark, the logo, the AlloVerified™ label and all Platform content (text, images, interfaces, source code) are the exclusive property of AlloAppart SN SARL and are protected by Senegalese intellectual property law.

Any reproduction, representation or exploitation without prior written authorisation is strictly prohibited.

responsabilite.title: 9. Limited liability
responsabilite.body:
AlloAppart acts as a technical intermediary and introduction service. AlloAppart is not a party to the lease agreement concluded between landlord and tenant and cannot be held liable for disputes arising within that relationship.

AlloAppart undertakes to keep the Platform available under normal conditions but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability.

suspension.title: 10. Account suspension and termination
suspension.body:
AlloAppart reserves the right to suspend or terminate a user account without notice in the event of:
• Breach of these ToS.
• Provision of false or misleading information.
• Proven fraudulent behaviour or attempted fraud.
• A court decision or an order from a competent authority.

Users may delete their account at any time from the settings of their personal space.

droit.title: 11. Governing law and jurisdiction
droit.body:
These ToS are governed by the law of the Republic of Senegal.

In the event of a dispute relating to the interpretation or performance of these ToS, and failing an amicable settlement within 30 days, the parties agree to submit the dispute to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Tribunal de Grande Instance of Dakar.

responsable.title: 1. Data controller
responsable.body: AlloAppart SN SARL, a limited liability company with share capital of 10,000,000 FCFA, registered in the Trade and Personal Property Credit Register under number RCCM SN-DKR-2024-B-12345, with registered office at 25 Rue Carnot, Plateau, Dakar 11000, Senegal, is the controller of your personal data in connection with your use of the AlloAppart platform.

donnees.title: 2. Data collected
donnees.body:
We collect the following categories of data:
• Identity data: surname, first name, date of birth.
• Contact data: email address, phone number.
• Browsing data: IP address, cookies, pages visited, session duration.
• Payment data: information required for the transaction (processed by our approved payment partners).
• Listing data: photos, descriptions and location of properties published by landlords.

finalites.title: 3. Purposes of processing
finalites.body:
Your data is processed for the following purposes:
• Connecting landlords and tenants through the platform.
• Improving our services and the user experience.
• Communication regarding your account, your listings or your searches.
• Compliance with our legal and regulatory obligations.

baselegale.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
baselegale.body:
In accordance with Senegalese Law No. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on the protection of personal data, our processing is based on:
• Your express consent given at registration.
• Performance of the service contract between AlloAppart and the user.
• Our legitimate interest in improving and securing our services.

conservation.title: 5. Retention period
conservation.body:
• Account data: retained for the lifetime of the account, then 3 years after deletion for legal archiving purposes.
• Login and browsing logs: rolling 12 months.
• Payment data: periods imposed by the applicable financial regulations.

destinataires.title: 6. Data recipients
destinataires.body:
Your data may be shared with:
• AlloVerified™ agents responsible for on-site property inspections.
• Our approved payment partners (Orange Money, Wave, etc.).
• Our hosting provider and technical subcontractors, bound by strict confidentiality obligations.
We never sell your data to third parties for commercial purposes.

droits.title: 7. User rights
droits.body:
In accordance with Law No. 2008-12, you have the following rights:
• Right of access to your personal data.
• Right to rectification of inaccurate data.
• Right to erasure (right to be forgotten).
• Right to data portability.
• Right to object to processing.

To exercise these rights, contact us at alloappart221@gmail.com or by post at our registered office.

transferts.title: 8. Transfers outside Senegal
transferts.body: Any transfer of personal data to a third country is carried out in accordance with the decisions of Senegal's Personal Data Protection Commission (CDP), in particular by requiring appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses, countries recognised as providing an adequate level of protection).

securite.title: 9. Security
securite.body:
AlloAppart implements the following technical and organisational measures to protect your data:
• Encryption of communications via the TLS protocol (HTTPS).
• Password hashing with a robust cryptographic algorithm (bcrypt).
• Regular security audits and penetration testing.
• Strict internal access control based on the principle of least privilege.

dpo.title: 10. Data Protection Officer (DPO) contact
dpo.body:
For any question relating to your personal data:
• Email: alloappart221@gmail.com
• Post: AlloAppart SN SARL — DPO, 25 Rue Carnot, Plateau, Dakar 11000, Senegal

cdp.title: 11. Lodging a complaint with the CDP
cdp.body:
If you believe your rights are not being respected, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Commission (CDP), the competent supervisory authority in Senegal.

Commission de Protection des Données Personnelles (CDP)
Dakar, Senegal — www.cdp.sn

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: How AlloAppart uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience.
cookies.whatBody: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. Cookies allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a period of time, so you do not have to keep re-entering them whenever you come back to the site or browse from one page to another.
cookies.rowSessionDur: Deleted when the browser is closed
cookies.rowThirdDur: According to the third party policy
cookies.manageBody:
You can manage your cookie preferences at any time:

• Via your browser settings: each browser offers options to block, delete or restrict cookies. Refer to your browser’s help section for detailed instructions.
• Via the consent management button: use the "Cookie settings" button at the bottom of each page to withdraw or adjust your consent at any time.

Note: disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the platform.
cookies.contactBody: For any question about our cookie policy, please contact us at:
cookies.footnote: This policy is complementary to our Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.
cookies.prevalence: The French version is the legally binding text. This English translation is provided for convenience only; in the event of any discrepancy in interpretation, the French version prevails.

necessaires.title: 2. Strictly necessary cookies
necessaires.body:
These cookies are essential for the platform to work and cannot be disabled. They include in particular:
• User session cookies (keeping you signed in).
• Authentication cookies (securing your personal space).
• CSRF security tokens (protection against cross-site attacks).

No consent is required for these cookies.

performance.title: 3. Performance cookies
performance.body:
These cookies collect anonymous data about how visitors use our platform (most visited pages, time spent, errors encountered). This information helps us improve our service.

The data collected is strictly anonymised and cannot be used to identify you personally. Your consent is required.

preferences.title: 4. Preference cookies
preferences.body:
These cookies remember your preferences in order to personalise your experience:
• Selected interface language (French, English).
• Theme preference (light / dark).
• Saved search filters.

Your consent is required to enable these cookies.

tiers.title: 5. Third-party cookies
tiers.body:
We use Google Maps to display the interactive map of property listings. This third-party service may place its own cookies on your device, subject to Google's privacy policy (policies.google.com).

We encourage you to read Google's policy to understand how this data is used.
